meta.name: opencode-qa
meta.description: QA opencode itself, per case: verify the CLI/terminal (opencode run, db, serve, export), prove a specific plugin hook/action/event fired via the SSE event stream, smoke-test the TUI under tmux, and investigate sessions in opencode's SQLite DB by id, title/name, or message text. Ships tested helper scripts (each with a --self-test) plus per-domain references. Use whenever someone wants to QA, smoke-test, verify, or debug opencode's CLI, HTTP server, plugin hooks/events, or TUI, or to find/inspect opencode sessions in the database. Triggers: opencode qa, qa opencode, test opencode, verify opencode hook, opencode session db, find opencode session by id/name/text, opencode tui test, opencode server health, opencode event stream.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 验证 AI 编程助手的命令、界面与数据记录是否正常
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要验证 opencode 的命令、插件触发及会话数据是否正常
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work on or use an AI coding assistant and need to verify its CLI, plugin events, or session history

howto.what: 收到“检查 opencode 这个工具本身”的请求后,Claude 会根据需要运行配套脚本:测试它的命令行、事件通知和操作界面是否正常,或按编号、标题、内容查找并导出历史会话。涉及启动工具的测试会隔离,避免污染真实数据;脚本都带自检。
howto.when: 当你说“检测 opencode”“测试 opencode”等,或要求检查某个功能/事件是否触发、按编号/标题/内容查找历史会话时,会触发这个技能。

say.text: 帮我检查 opencode 的命令行功能是否正常。
say.note: 会运行对应的命令测试脚本并汇报结果。

say.text: 验证刚才那个事件是否真的触发了。
把标题含“权限”的最近 20 个会话列出来。
say.note: 会用按标题查找的数据库脚本列出结果。

howto.what_en: Asked to QA opencode itself, Claude runs bundled helper scripts to test CLI commands, server events, and TUI, or find/export sessions by id/title/text. Launches use an isolated sandbox; scripts include a self-test.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to QA or test opencode, check whether a feature/event fired, or look up database sessions by title or content.

say_en.text: Check whether opencode's command-line behavior is normal.
say_en.note: Runs the matching command-test script and reports.

say_en.text: Verify whether that event actually fired.
say_en.note: Listens to the event stream to confirm.

say_en.text: List the 20 most recent sessions whose title has “permission”.
say_en.note: Uses the by-title database script to list results.
